source_provenance.required_geometry: The original Run40 normal scientific source consumes full R740, R742, R744, R746, R747 and R748 geometry plus the Run39 profile-grid utility. It consumes no Run39 or 39b fields or clocks.
source_provenance.immutable_trigger: Every listed source must exist with the stated complete identity in the actual launch tree, including the R748 source supplied separately by the mathematical author.

scientific_budget.locked_promotion: Old locked shape space at every prior span count remains as actual independently named basis functions, including nonnested 3-to-4 and 8-to-12 spline changes. New central directions sum with the locked window to the full grip-only window. Positive cap center point and first jet remain held in physical corrections.
scientific_budget.full_time_evaluation: Every positive phase knot is explicitly solved, followed by midpoint tests and, on all three refinement levels, two separate interior off-knot check phases per subinterval. The last level has 16 intervals and 65 independent-check phase samples including endpoints.

mathematics: Keep the one actual R747 zero-phase metric, both original surfaces of the closed caps and both moving rolled ends. Solve the actual nonlinear shape at each prescribed phase, then evaluate the natural time spline in the complete spatial atlas including the grip, its exterior and two regular cap-center charts. Five complete starts and three full positive-time refinements have their original budgets. If the locked coarse comparison wins, retain every old global and cap column, all preceding Fourier/T and rolled spline modes and add the extra (free minus locked) physical central columns in three components. Copy each shared coefficient literally and initialize new columns at zero before optimization. The coarse, expanded and other free branches retain their actual design and field identities. The ordinary free branch uses its stated least-squares spline warm start. The true C2 fractional end jet w^(5/2)(1-w)^4 and both ends remain active.
